question: How do I request a refund for an accidental purchase or duplicate order?
answer: You can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase under our 30-day money-back guarantee. Go to Account Settings > Billing & Subscriptions and click 'Request Refund', or submit a ticket with your transaction ID.

question: Can I cancel my subscription and get a prorated refund?
answer: Annual plan subscribers can cancel anytime and receive a prorated refund for unused full calendar months, subject to a 10% administrative fee. Monthly subscriptions remain active until the end of the paid billing cycle without refunds.

question: How long does it take for a refund to show up on my credit card statement?
answer: Once approved, refunds are processed immediately. Depending on your financial institution, funds typically appear on your statement within 3 to 5 business days.

question: What is the return policy for damaged or defective physical products?
answer: Defective physical items must be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery with original packaging. Customer support provides a prepaid return shipping label upon photo verification of damage.

question: How do I reset my account password if I forgot it?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your registered email, and a secure password reset link valid for 15 minutes will be emailed to you.

question: What should I do if my Two-Factor Authentication 2FA code is not working?
answer: Use one of your 10 emergency backup recovery codes generated during 2FA setup. If you do not have backup codes, submit an identity verification ticket to initiate manual account recovery.

question: Why is my account locked or suspended due to failed login attempts?
answer: For security protection, accounts are temporarily locked for 30 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. You can wait 30 minutes or click 'Forgot Password' to unlock immediately.

question: I received an alert about a suspicious login from an unknown IP address. What should I do?
answer: Click 'This Wasn't Me' in the security alert email immediately. This will terminate all active sessions across all devices, revoke API tokens, and prompt you to set a new password.

question: Why was my credit card charged twice for the same billing period?
answer: Duplicate charges usually result from network timeouts during checkout. The duplicate pre-authorization hold will automatically fall off your bank account within 3 to 5 business days.

question: How do I update my credit card or payment method on file?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Billing & Invoices > Payment Methods. Click 'Add Payment Method', enter your new card details, and set it as default.

question: Where can I download PDF copies of my paid invoices with VAT/tax details?
answer: Invoices are available under Account Settings > Invoices. Click 'Download PDF' next to any billing period. You can add your company VAT/tax ID under Billing Information before downloading.

question: My payment failed due to insufficient funds. When will you retry charging my card?
answer: Our billing system automatically retries failed payments on Day 1, Day 4, and Day 7. A 7-day grace period is provided before subscription features are paused.

question: How can I track the shipping and delivery status of my order?
answer: Once your order ships, a tracking number and courier link are emailed to you. You can also view live tracking status anytime in your account under 'Order History'.

question: Why has my tracking number not updated for several days?
answer: Tracking numbers are generated when the label is printed. Carrier scans may take 24 to 48 hours to update once the carrier physically scans the parcel at the origin sorting hub.

question: What should I do if tracking says delivered but I did not receive my package?
answer: First check surrounding areas and with neighbors. Couriers occasionally scan deliveries prematurely. If the parcel does not arrive within 24 hours of the delivery notification, contact support to file a carrier trace.

question: Can I change my shipping address or expedite shipping after placing an order?
answer: Shipping address and delivery speed can only be modified within 60 minutes of placing the order before the warehouse begins fulfillment. Contact live chat support immediately for order adjustments.

question: The application crashes immediately upon opening or displays a white screen.
answer: Try clearing your browser cache and cookies or restarting the desktop client. Ensure your device meets minimum system requirements and hardware acceleration is enabled.

question: How do I resolve API HTTP 429 Too Many Requests rate limit errors?
answer: HTTP 429 indicates you have exceeded your plan's rate limit quota. Implement exponential backoff retries in your client application or upgrade your plan for higher throughput.

question: Webhooks are failing or timing out when delivering payloads to our server.
answer: Ensure your webhook listener endpoint responds with an HTTP 200 OK status within 5000 milliseconds. Our servers automatically retry failed deliveries up to 5 times with exponential backoff.

question: CSV file upload fails with internal server error 500.
answer: Verify that your CSV file is UTF-8 encoded, under 50MB in size, and does not contain unescaped quotation marks in header rows. Download our sample CSV template from the documentation.

question: What are customer support business hours and response times?
answer: Our standard customer support operates Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Critical severity issues for enterprise tier customers receive 24/7 coverage with a 1-hour response SLA.

question: Do you offer non-profit, student, or educational discounts?
answer: Yes! Verified non-profit organizations and accredited educational institutions qualify for a 30% discount on all annual software plans upon submitting proof of status.

question: Is customer data encrypted and compliant with SOC2 and GDPR regulations?
answer: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256. We maintain SOC2 Type II certification and offer full GDPR-compliant Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).

question: Does your platform support Single Sign-On (SSO) with Okta or Google Workspace?
answer: Yes, SAML 2.0 and OIDC Single Sign-On are supported for Okta, Azure Active Directory, Google Workspace, and OneLogin on Business and Enterprise plans.
